resources.string: Enter the host’s PIN and passphrase.\nThe PIN expires after three minutes.
Enter the four-digit PIN from the host.
Enter the host passphrase (at least four characters).

1. Start a Moonlight-compatible host on the PC, such as Apollo, Rubylight, Sunshine or Vibepollo.\n2. On Android, select the PC on the same network.\n3. Enter the PIN shown on Android in your host’s settings or web UI.
